newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope sends condolences to Guatamela soccer victims.
newsitem.headline: Pope sends condolences to Guatamela soccer victims.

text.p: Pope John Paul, "deeply saddened" by the Guatamelan soccer stadium tragedy, on Thursday sent a message of condolence to relatives of the victims.

The Pope's message was contained in a telegram from Cardinal Angelo Sodano, the Vatican's Secretary of State, to Monsignor Victor Hugo Martinez Contreras, Archbishop of Quetzaltenango-Los Altos. A text was released by the Vatican.

"The Holy Father offers his prayers for the eternal rest of the dead and asks the Lord for the quick return to health of the injured and his consolation to those who suffered the separation from their loved ones," telegram said.
At least 79 fans were killed in a stampede at the Mateo Flores stadium in Guatemala City before Wednesday's World Cup match between Guatemala and Costa Rica. Some 150 were injured.
